options.content: **Infrastructure** — Kubernetes nodes and pods (kubelet / cAdvisor, kube-state-metrics, node-exporter), PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and MongoDB exporters, and the health of every Prometheus scrape target.

panels.title: Pods not ready
panels.description: Running pods whose readiness probe fails (no traffic sent to them).

panels.title: OOMKilled (last restart)
panels.description: Containers whose last restart was caused by hitting their memory limit.

panels.title: Node memory used
panels.description: All kind nodes share the Docker Desktop VM's memory.

panels.title: Disk free (Docker VM)
panels.description: /var on the kind nodes (images, volumes) is the Docker Desktop VM disk: when it fills up, pulls and volumes fail.

panels.title: Memory vs limit — closest to being OOMKilled first
panels.description: Working set as a share of the memory limit. Above ~90% the pod is at risk of OOMKill.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", image!=""}) / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"}) > 0

panels.title: Restarts by pod (time range)
panels.description: Empty = no restarts in the time range.

panels.title: Dead-lettered
panels.description: Messages that failed processing 3 times. Should always be 0.
